reviews.text: The packaging is so cute but I think the colour payoff could be better
reviews.zh: 包裝好得意，但我覺得顯色度可以再好啲。

reviews.text: This is a good palette. Its nicely pigmented not crazy pigmented but it does have good color payoff. Its easy to blend and the colors are very pretty. Packaging is super cute too. I recommend if youre looking for a cute and decently pigmented palette.
reviews.zh: 呢個眼影盤幾好。顯色適中，唔算超級顯色但係都有唔錯嘅顯色度。容易推開，顏色好靚。包裝亦都好得意。如果你搵緊一個得意又顯色適中嘅眼影盤，我推薦呢個。

reviews.text: such a adorable [MY MELODY & KUROMI EDITION] AMUSE Flora Eye Palette (+Acrylic Charm, Seal Sticker) [KUROMI] 02 Roserina. Adding this to my collection.
reviews.zh: 好可愛嘅 [MY MELODY & KUROMI EDITION] AMUSE Flora Eye Palette (+Acrylic Charm, Seal Sticker) [KUROMI] 02 Roserina。加咗入我嘅收藏。

reviews.text: The palette is alot smaller than I imagined regardless it’s adorable and perfect to take on the go. The packaging reminds me of kid’s makeup which makes it cuter and nostalgic. Colors are beautiful and blend like butter.
reviews.zh: 眼影盤比我想像中細好多，不過依然好得意，帶出街好方便。包裝令我諗起細個嘅化妝品，越睇越可愛又帶啲懷舊感。顏色好靚，推開好似牛油咁滑。

reviews.text: It's super cute. you have the choice of 6 colors in a range. it's perfect for the road. the colors are okay picmented and easy to apply. all in one very good
reviews.zh: 超級可愛。有 6 種顏色可以選擇。帶出街好方便。顏色顯色度 OK，好容易上色。整體嚟講好好。

reviews.text: This one is really good.It's a little better than the my melody one.I would say and it's really good.It's got nice pinky shades, but they're not so pigmented that you'll look like clowny.You look so good.Got some natural shades, but also some darker shades to make the perfect eye look with just one palette.And also, you can use the shades for blush and highlighter, which make it such a versatile palette.You could take it with you because it's a keychain, and it doesn't easily snap open, which is really nice if you just want to take it with you.I wish the chrome pattern was painted on top or printed on top instead of being just a plastic piece in the middle because it's really annoying having to tick it out and put it back in.But that's my only complaint, and overall, it's a really good product.You should try it out.
reviews.zh: 呢個真係好正。比起 my melody 嗰款稍為好少少。我會咁講，而且真係好正。有靚嘅粉紅色號，但唔會顯色到好似小丑咁。用完望落好好睇。有啲自然色，亦有啲深色，一盒 palette 就可以打造完美眼妝。而且啲色號可以用嚟做胭脂同 highlight，非常多功能。掛喺鎖匙扣就可以帶出街，而且唔會好易彈開，淨係想帶出街嘅話真係好方便。我希望個 chrome 圖案係印或者貼喺表面，而唔係中間嵌住一塊膠片，因為要成日攞出嚟同塞返入去真係好煩。但呢個係我唯一嘅投訴，整體嚟講真係好正嘅產品。大家不妨試吓。

reviews.text: This is a good palette. Its nicely pigmented not crazy pigmented but it does have good color payoff. Its easy to blend and the colors are very pretty. Packaging is super cute too. I recommend if youre looking for a cute and decently pigmented palette.
reviews.zh: 呢盒 palette 唔錯。顯色度幾好，唔算超級顯色，但 color payoff 幾好。容易 blend，顏色好靚。包裝超級得意。如果你想搵一盒得意又顯色度合理嘅 palette，我推薦呢盒。

reviews.text: I’m really happy with my order from Olive Young! The product is exactly as described and works so well — the quality is great and it feels nice to use. The packaging was neat and everything arrived in perfect condition. Shipping was faster than I expected, and the whole process was smooth from start to finish. I’ve always heard good things about Olive Young, and now I understand why! I’ll definitely order again in the future because the experience was so easy and reliable.
reviews.zh: 今次喺 Olive Young 落單真係好滿意！產品完全符合描述，而且好好用——品質好，用起嚟感覺唔錯。包裝整齊，所有嘢都完好無缺送達。寄送比預期快，由頭到尾成個過程都好順暢。一直以嚟都聽到 Olive Young 嘅好口碑，而家終於明白點解！體驗咁方便可靠，將來一定會再落單。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
